subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Lucid Dreaming in Tradition
description: Learn Lucid Dreaming in Tradition in one minute.

hook.text: Tibetan Buddhists practiced dream yoga for centuries. They learned to stay aware while dreaming.

buildup.text: Dream yoga treats waking life as equally dreamlike. Control in dreams teaches control in life.

discovery.text: Science confirmed lucid dreaming in 1975. Sleepers signaled researchers by moving their eyes.

twist.text: Indigenous cultures worldwide used lucid dreams for vision quests and spirit communication.

climax.text: Ancient practitioners mapped states of consciousness that neuroscience is only now measuring.

quiz.question: What is lucid dreaming?
options: Being aware you're dreaming while asleep
